lead.headline: Rice is out again — but Bloodsports have their first win locked, 131.8 to 88.62
lead.deck: Golden (22.4) and Pickens (13.3) finished last night; Daniels plays Monday with nothing left to decide.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice missed a second straight week with no return date, Garrett Wilson finished 8.4 on six targets, and C.J. Stroud's 23.0 sat on the bench. It did not matter: Tuten (24.7), Likely (23.9), Golden (22.4) and Taylor (21.1) put Bloodsports at 131.8 against a finished 88.62, and Daniels still plays Monday. Two calls closed right overnight — Golden over Tate by 3.4, and the Pickens claim over Josh Downs. Week 7: Daniels and Tuten are on bye; Stroud starts at quarterback and Josh Jacobs, reinstated today, competes with Gordon for Tuten's slot on Tuesday's projection. The Giants have not named Likely's Week 7 quarterback. New this afternoon: Jacobs is off the exempt list, but LaFleur will not commit to him for Week 7 — a full practice week first, status "to be determined" (Packers.com 19 Oct) — so Gordon is the likelier cover for Tuten. Diggs is expected back for Daniels tonight.
